description: This file contains a backtesting framework using Backtrader, integrating Alpaca API for data retrieval, and implementing a SMA crossover trading strategy with analysis and plotting.

classes.name: SmaCross
classes.description: A Backtrader strategy implementing SMA crossover with trade tracking and holding period analysis.

methods.name: run_backtest
methods.description: Executes a backtest with specified strategy, symbol, date range, and parameters, then outputs performance metrics and plots.

methods.name: strategy_statistics
methods.description: Analyzes backtest results, calculating metrics like Sharpe ratio, win rate, profit factor, max return/loss, and buy-and-hold return.
